title: Attention-Aware Routing: Coupling Routing and Attention in MoEs
abstract: arXiv:2609.20974v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In Mixture-of-Experts language models, the router typically selects and weights experts based on the token's hidden state, utilizing limited contextual information. We propose Attention-Aware Routing (AAR), which augments the router with temporal and spectral features extracted from a sliding window of attention weights that represent a summary of the model's contextual state, disentangled from the hidden state. Keeping the base transformer entirely frozen, we train only the routing parameters, isolating routing as the sole variable. AAR improves GSM8K by +3.37 pp over a routing-only SFT baseline on OLMoE. Beyond performance, we show that routing and attention form a coupled circuit: routing changes at layer l propagate through the residual stream to amplify attention sinks at layer l+1, reshaping attention without any direct update to the attention mechanism itself. Further, AAR reduces long diverging generation, with incorrect answers

translated_title: 注意力感知路由：在混合专家模型中耦合路由与注意力
translated_abstract: 在混合专家语言模型中，路由器通常基于词元的隐藏状态来选择和加权专家，所利用的上下文信息十分有限。我们提出了注意力感知路由，它利用从注意力权重滑动窗口中提取的时域与频域特征来增强路由器，这些特征代表了模型上下文状态的摘要，并与隐藏状态解耦。在保持基础Transformer完全冻结的前提下，我们仅训练路由参数，从而将路由隔离为唯一变量。在OLMoE上，AAR相比仅路由的SFT基线将GSM8K性能提升了3.37个百分点。除性能提升外，我们还证明了路由与注意力构成一个耦合电路：第l层的路由变化通过残差流传播，放大第l+1层的注意力汇聚现象，从而在不对注意力机制本身进行任何直接更新的情况下重塑注意力。此外，AAR减少了长篇发散生成，错误答案……
tldr: 提出注意力感知路由（AAR），利用从注意力权重滑动窗口提取的时域与频域特征增强MoE路由器，在冻结主干、仅训练路由参数的情况下将GSM8K提升3.37个百分点，并首次揭示了路由变化经残差流传播以重塑注意力的耦合电路机制。
en_tdlr: Proposes Attention-Aware Routing (AAR), which augments MoE routers with temporal and spectral features from attention weight windows, improving GSM8K by +3.37 pp with a fully frozen backbone while revealing a coupled circuit in which routing changes propagate through the residual stream to reshape attention.
